name: nextjs
description: Next.js 15 App Router + React 19 + TypeScript strict + Tailwind CSS v4 + shadcn/ui + Zustand

notes.serverCode: framework-builtin — Route Handlers and Server Actions are the default home for server code. Even when the backend axis is a BaaS, the server logic lives here
notes.language: The default is TypeScript strict. Pick JavaScript and the type-standard slot is replaced by JSDoc conventions and runtime validation (a schema library), and the generated-types (DB schema→types) section drops out
